summary_1line: Kartikeya’s miraculous upbringing and gifts from the gods lead to Taraka’s defeat; Bhishma then begins teaching Yudhishthira the rites and merits of Sraddha.

image_candidates.scene_text: The radiant six‑headed child Kartikeya lies in a forest of reeds as the six Krittikas gather around to nurse and raise him.
Hosts of gods, rishis, and celestial beings assemble around the glowing infant Kumara, offering animals, birds, and treasures as gifts.
The youthful Skanda hurls his irresistible spear and slays the Asura Taraka while the celestial hosts look on in triumph.
